tools.name: read_source
tools.description: Read a LaTeX file. Choose path and chunk, or locate before. Returns source text and chunk count.

tools.name: replace_source
tools.description: Change an existing literal layout setting using one unique before/after source span. Keep document content and asset paths.

tools.name: compile_pdf
tools.description: Generate the current PDF. Returns its hash and compiler findings.

tools.name: inspect_pdf
tools.description: Check the current PDF for overlaps, clipping, column and caption findings.

tools.name: render_pages
tools.description: View up to four candidate pages. Page indices start at zero.

tools.name: read_reference
tools.description: Read original PDF text and source regions. Continue each page with its returned next arguments until next is null.

tools.name: render_reference_pages
tools.description: View up to four original pages. Request matching candidate pages with render_pages.

tools.name: restructure_source
tools.description: Set full-width front matter, body order, columns and header/footer units. Include every current unit once.

tools.name: finish
tools.description: Return the chosen candidate and a brief account of changes and remaining findings.

tools.name: inspect_document
tools.description: List and search document blocks, fonts and figures. Continue with offset. Geometry identifies original and current positions.

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: Read one block, its source, positions and associated assets. Continue source text with offset, geometry hits with geometryOffset, and asset paths with assetOffset.

tools.name: render_region
tools.description: View an enlarged original or candidate rectangle. bbox is [left,top,right,bottom] in display points from the top left; use the geometry coordinateFrame.

tools.name: update_layout
tools.description: Adjust one block by ID. Set spacing, type size, width, placement or neighboring block. Text stays unchanged.

tools.name: compare_document
tools.description: Compare candidate content and assets with the captured pre-layout PDF, including the selected RED changes.

tools.name: checkpoint
tools.description: Save the current source as a named revision. A matching generated PDF is saved when available.

tools.name: restore_revision
tools.description: Return to a saved revision. Use revision IDs listed in execution.checkpoints.

tools.name: inspect_fonts
tools.description: List project font files and inspect character coverage for text.

tools.name: set_typography
tools.description: Set document type size, leading and a font available in this project.

tools.name: read_table
tools.description: Read source tables and cell previews. Select a table ID and continue its rows with rowOffset.

tools.name: rebuild_table
tools.description: Typeset an observed table with the same cells, labels and precision. Set column widths or span; rows can describe content already present in current blocks.

tools.name: get_figure
tools.description: List figures, panels, captions and project images, or read one selected figure.

tools.name: place_figure
tools.description: Size and place a figure with its caption. Preserve aspect ratio and image content.

tools.name: replace_figure
tools.description: Replace one figure occurrence with a replacement image supplied by the user. Choose an allowed replacement path.
